evidence.quote: You've misconfigured the sink, and inadvertently used the Confluent JDBC sink configuration property names rather than the Debezium JDBC sink property names"; reporter confirmed fix.

notes: Sink config used pk.mode/pk.fields (Confluent names) so Debezium JDBC sink ignored them and used defaults, inserting rows with PK 0. JdbcSinkConnectorConfig's property names settle it.
